youtube.title: What if you were a gong farmer for one night?
youtube.description:
Tudor London, 9 p.m.: your night shift as a gong farmer starts – emptying the city's toilet pits by hand, before sunrise. 🕯️🪣 One of the worst jobs in history… and surprisingly well paid.
Would you take this job? A) Yes, for the money B) Only with a nose peg C) Never – Comment A, B or C 👇
Sources: City of London, "The Laws of the Market" (no gong farmer may carry ordure before 9 at night, fine 13s 4d); Emily Cockayne, "Hubbub: Filth, Noise & Stench in England" (2007); Tony Robinson, "The Worst Jobs in History" (2004)
